Indian Polity in 72 Hours

72 hours before 6 December 2026 for UPPSC Prelims 2026.

Start with hour 1 →

Complete syllabus coverage in 48 hours of focused reading, 20 hours of rapid revision, and 4 timed full-length mocks. Every hour has its reading points and real UPPSC PYQs.

Phase 1: Learn

Hours 1–48: All 42 chapters structured into 48 intensive sessions. Read high-yield summaries and solve matching PYQs.

Start Hour 1 →

Phase 2: Revise

Hours 49–68: 20 rapid revision hours focusing on repeated facts, landmark judgments, key articles, and constitutional amendments.

Jump to Revision →

Phase 3: Test

Hours 69–72: 4 timed mocks with high-yield questions simulating real UPPSC exam conditions.

Jump to Tests →
